scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Technology Acquisition
other_conditions: The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise.
Technology must be acquired from a recognized institution or technology provider.
Applicant must obtain prior approval from the MSME Commissionerate within one year of signing the MoU.
Technology should be related to product or process improvement.
benefits_summary: Provides financial support covering 65% of technology acquisition cost up to ₹5,000,000 and assistance for royalty payments for the first two years.
